rule: party tables store mutable state only; canonical world facts remain referenced by text IDs, not copied as truth unless materialized
code may create IDs, validate structure and write accepted LLM output; it must not invent NPCs/items/events/causes
current position must keep region_id/place_id/location_id/minilocation_id/anchor_id/last_route_id when available
hidden_state must never be passed directly to player-facing prose
party_items.materialization_reason is mandatory for significant items
party_map_knowledge stores character knowledge, not factual graph truth
after elapsed time, update body/NPC/place/events before visible scene
party_events.cause is mandatory; event cannot appear without cause
invalid LLM output must create validation issue/repair step, not silent placeholder content
